summary: Authenticated backend regression passed for trade CRUD, notes, dashboard, all PDF periods, and AI briefing. Mobile web preview loaded at 390x844 and login/dashboard/journal creation/navigation partially passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Combined Playwright flow stopped on a brittle visible-text assertion immediately after create; the created trade was visibly present in the screenshot, but this flow needs a stable selector and full retest.

action_items: Add data-testid/testID attributes to auth fields/buttons, tabs, journal controls, settings controls, report actions, and AI states for reliable mobile regression testing.
Run a complete UI retest for edit/delete/filter, discipline notes, account switching/deletion, settings target mode, notifications, PDF opening, and AI response after selectors are stabilized.

Align frontend API configuration with the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL convention or document the existing EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL convention; current live configuration works but the source does not use EXPO_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend source uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the stated environment contract specifies EXPO_BACKEND_URL; this is a deployment/configuration risk.
Several screen interactions have no testID, making critical flows difficult to automate robustly.
Expo logs an expected web limitation warning for notification push-token support; permission/scheduling behavior is not verifiable as native functionality in web preview.

success_rate.frontend: partial: login/dashboard/journal create/navigation passed; remaining flows not completed

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST-prefixed trades and note through regression tests. One QA journal trade created during UI testing remains in the QA account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use qa.apextrade@example.com / ApexTrade123. Backend tests are reusable and pass. Preview is https://trader-daily-tracker.preview.emergentagent.com. UI selectors currently rely mostly on text/accessibility labels because testIDs are absent.
rca_of_issue: The UI run did not fail at the journal operation itself: the trade appeared correctly and the screenshot showed XAUUSD Compra +125.00 USD. The combined script halted on a strict text assertion, and the lack of stable testIDs prevents reliable continuation. This is a testability gap rather than confirmed journal business-logic failure.
